title: 会议记录怎样写成可以执行的行动项
topic: 会议记录怎样写成可以执行的行动项

source.title: Writing Meeting Notes for Action - Dropbox
source.section: Steps 1–3: Take the lead; use names and formatting; listen for questions and actions
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 依据 Dropbox 官方 Write notes for action 指南。逐字记录发言者和重点；编号方便引用，缩进呈现完整对话线索；只在情况需要时标注负责人和期限。教学中的会议情境和人物为模拟，不代表 Dropbox 案例。
paragraphs: Ask any athlete and they’ll tell you: there’s no substitute for more reps. By proactively volunteering to lead notetaking in your next meeting, you inject focus into the process. Other attendees are free to talk and engage without worrying if their ideas are being documented, while you’re empowered to put your energy toward capturing key moments, challenges, questions, and action items. For agenda-led meetings, put your notes in the shared agenda. For other instances, you can capture in a collaborative document like Dropbox Paper and share after the meeting.

When you’re documenting real-time notes, write the speaker’s name before the note. Knowing who was speaking allows those reading your notes to gain context on the person — and in turn, their role and perspective. Go a step further by using smart formatting. Numbered lists are more citable than bulleted lists as they provide a specific number to refer back to, and indentations enable you to document a complete thread of conversation while avoiding run-on thoughts.

The quickest way to ensure you’re only documenting the most important takeaways (as opposed to a transcript) is to listen for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to action. If the situation calls for it, tag people and specify due dates. These are the most vital elements to refer back to, and it ensures that those who could not attend the meeting — or those who may be interested at a later time — have a clear view of what went unanswered and what comes next.
translations: 问任何一位运动员，他们都会告诉你：没有什么能替代更多的重复练习。通过主动提议在下次会议中担任记录员，你可以为这个过程注入专注。其他与会者可以自由交谈和参与，而不用担心他们的想法是否被记录下来，同时你也能够将精力集中在捕捉关键时刻、挑战、问题和行动项上。对于有议程引导的会议，将你的笔记放在共享议程中。对于其他情况，你可以在像 Dropbox Paper 这样的协作文档中记录，并在会后分享。
当你记录实时笔记时，在笔记前写下发言者的名字。让阅读你笔记的人了解发言者的背景——进而了解他们的角色和观点。更进一步，使用智能格式。编号列表比项目符号列表更易于引用，因为它们提供了特定的编号供回头参考，而缩进则使你能够记录完整的对话线程，同时避免思绪混乱。
确保只记录最重要的要点（而不是逐字记录）的最快方法是倾听问题、后续请求和行动号召。如果情况需要，可以标记人员并指定截止日期。这些是回头参考的最重要元素，它确保了未能参加会议的人——或者以后可能感兴趣的人——能够清楚地了解哪些问题没有得到解答，接下来会发生什么。

notes.phrase: put your energy toward capturing key moments
notes.meaning: 将精力投入到捕捉关键时刻上
notes.explain: 这个短语强调在会议记录时应该专注于记录最重要的内容，而不是试图记录所有内容
notes.example: During the brainstorming session, she put her energy toward capturing key moments rather than writing down every comment.

notes.phrase: write the speaker’s name before the note
notes.meaning: 在笔记前标明发言者姓名
notes.explain: 用姓名引出记录内容，读者便能判断是谁表达了观点，并理解其角色或视角。
notes.example: Lee: The access date is not confirmed.

notes.phrase: listen for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to action
notes.meaning: 留意问题、后续请求和行动事项
notes.explain: 这几类内容能帮助记录者筛出需要回看或跟进的重点，而非抄下整场对话。
notes.example: When taking minutes, the assistant focused on listening for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to action to ensure nothing was missed.

notes.phrase: tag people and specify due dates
notes.meaning: 标记人员并指定截止日期
notes.explain: 原文限定为“if the situation calls for it”：当责任人和期限已明确且有跟进需要时再标注，不能把推测写成已确认事实。
notes.example: In the project update meeting, the project manager tagged people and specified due dates for each action item to ensure accountability.

scenario.title: Turn a project review into useful shared notes
english: In a project review, Jordan asks whether the API access date is confirmed. Lee replies that the access team has not given a date yet.
Jordan asks Taylor to test the workflow by Thursday once access is available. Mei agrees to share the results by Friday. The team does not decide when access will be granted.
Write concise shared notes: name the speakers, number the discussion points, list each action with its owner and due date, and keep the unresolved question separate.
chinese: 项目评审会上，Jordan 询问 API 权限开放日期是否已确认。Lee 回答，权限团队还没有给出日期。
Jordan 请 Taylor 在权限开放后、最晚周四测试流程。Mei 同意周五前分享结果。团队没有决定何时开放权限。
整理简明的共享记录：标明发言者、给讨论点编号、为行动项写明负责人和期限，并把未解决的问题单独列出。

firstAttempt.prompt: 根据会议记录写一段简明英文共享笔记：Jordan 询问 API 权限开放日期，Lee 说日期尚未确定；Taylor 在权限开放后、最晚周四测试新流程；Mei 周五前分享结果。标出发言者，为行动项编号并写负责人/期限，另列未解决问题。
firstAttempt.sample:
1. Jordan: Asked when API access will be available. Lee: The date is not confirmed.
2. Action — Taylor: Test the new workflow by Thursday, once API access is available.
3. Action — Mei: Share the results by Friday.
Open question: When will API access be granted?
firstAttempt.rationale: 笔记保留发言者上下文，以编号列出讨论和行动，并把未知日期标为待确认；期限只用于已明确分配的任务。

words.example: The team did a few reps of the handoff before the launch.
words.translation: 上线前，团队把交接流程演练了几遍。
words.note: repetitions 的口语缩写，常指训练或练习的重复次数。

words.example: A one-line goal can inject focus into a meeting that keeps drifting.
words.translation: 给总是跑题的会议明确一句目标，就能让讨论重新聚焦。
words.note: 表示为某个过程或活动增加清晰度和方向感

words.example: Please add the owner and due date to the collaborative document.
words.translation: 请在协作文档中补上负责人和截止时间。
words.note: 指允许多人同时编辑的在线文档，促进团队协作

words.example: Smart formatting, such as a short action-item table, makes owners and deadlines easy to scan.
words.translation: 恰当的格式（如简短的行动项表格）能让负责人和截止日期一目了然。
words.note: 指有意识地使用格式技巧（如编号、缩进等）来增强文档的可读性和可用性

words.example: The notes include the key takeaways and next steps.
words.translation: 会议记录写下了关键结论和下一步。
words.note: 指会议或讨论中最重要、需要记住的信息或结论

words.example: Turn each decision into a clear action item with an owner.
words.translation: 把每项决定转成有明确负责人的行动事项。
words.note: 指会议中明确要求参与者采取的具体行动或任务

structure.original: Numbered lists are more citable than bulleted lists as they provide a specific number to refer back to, and indentations enable you to document a complete thread of conversation while avoiding run-on thoughts.
analysis: 主句中 Numbered lists 是主语，are more citable 是比较结构，than bulleted lists 引出比较对象。
as 在这里表示原因：编号列表提供可回指的具体编号，因此更容易在讨论中引用某条记录。
to refer back to 修饰 number，说明编号的用途是之后返回查看。
structure.transfer: Use numbered notes for decisions and open questions; indent a follow-up beneath the point it explains.

rewrite.bad: Taylor will test the workflow. Mei will share results. There are some questions.
rewrite.good:
1. Jordan: Asked when API access will be available. Lee: The date is not confirmed.
2. Action — Taylor: Test the new workflow by Thursday, once API access is available.
3. Action — Mei: Share the results by Friday.
Open question: When will API access be granted?
rewrite.translation:
1. Jordan：询问 API 权限何时开放。Lee：日期尚未确认。
2. 行动——Taylor：在 API 权限开放后、最晚周四测试新流程。
3. 行动——Mei：周五前分享结果。
待确认问题：何时会开放 API 权限？
rewrite.pattern: [number]. [Speaker]: [point]. Action — [owner]: [action] by [date], once [condition]. Open question: [unresolved question].

cloze.prompt: The quickest way to ensure you’re only documenting the most important ___ is to listen for questions and actions.
cloze.why: takeaways 指会议中值得记录和回看的要点。

cloze.prompt: Listen for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to ___.
cloze.why: calls to action 与问题和后续请求并列，是筛选会议重点的线索。

cloze.prompt: If the situation calls for it, tag people and specify due ___.
cloze.why: 原文说在适当情况下标记相关人员并写明期限。

dictation.text: When you’re documenting real-time notes, write the speaker’s name before the note.
Numbered lists are more citable than bulleted lists as they provide a specific number to refer back to.

translationPractice.prompt: 1. Jordan 询问 API 权限何时开放。Lee 说日期尚未确认。
translationPractice.answer: 1. Jordan: Asked when API access will be available. Lee: The date is not confirmed.
translationPractice.why: 用姓名标注发言者，并把问题和回复留在同一编号讨论点中。

translationPractice.prompt: 2. 行动——Taylor：在 API 权限开放后、最晚周四测试新流程。
translationPractice.answer: 2. Action — Taylor: Test the new workflow by Thursday, once API access is available.
translationPractice.why: Action — [owner] 写明负责人；by Thursday 是期限，once 引出前置条件。

translationPractice.prompt: 待确认问题：何时会开放 API 权限？
translationPractice.answer: Open question: When will API access be granted?
translationPractice.why: Open question 将尚无答案的问题独立列出，不把未知日期写成已确认。

choice.prompt: 共享记录中，Jordan 询问 API 权限时间，Lee 说日期未定；Taylor 最晚周四测试（以权限开放为前提），Mei 周五前分享结果。哪种记录最准确？
options: Taylor will test by Thursday; API access is confirmed for Monday. Mei will share results.

1. Jordan: Asked when API access will be available. Lee: The date is not confirmed.
2. Action — Taylor: Test the new workflow by Thursday, once API access is available.
3. Action — Mei: Share the results by Friday.
Open question: When will API access be granted?
The team discussed access, testing, and results. Follow up later.
choice.why: 准确记录发言者、行动负责人、期限和前提，并将未知的权限日期保留为问题。

output.prompt: 在一次发布复盘中，Nina 询问回滚窗口是否已确认，Omar 说还没有。Nina 请 Chen 在窗口确认后、最晚周三完成回滚清单；Rui 周四前分享监控摘要。请写带发言者的编号共享笔记、行动负责人/期限和待确认问题。
output.sample:
1. Nina: Asked whether the rollback window is confirmed. Omar: It is not confirmed yet.
2. Action — Chen: Complete the rollback checklist by Wednesday, once the window is confirmed.
3. Action — Rui: Share the monitoring summary by Thursday.
Open question: When will the rollback window be confirmed?
check: 是否标明 Nina 与 Omar 的说话内容？
是否为两项行动写明负责人、期限和前提？
是否把尚未确认的回滚窗口单独列出？
